title: Enter image requests get a clearer path
summary:
Image requests got more predictable, Flux stopped quietly switching models, and the sites tidied up their logos.

Enter image requests now bypass the image service’s per-IP queue, and its nanobanana requests skip the hourly per-IP check. Other nanobanana requests remain limited to 10 images per hour; unauthenticated image requests have a longer queue interval and lower concurrency caps.

If Flux generation fails, the API now returns the original error rather than silently producing an image with a different model.

The sites now draw favicons, app icons and social previews from consolidated logo assets. Pollinations.ai and Enter also received refreshed icons and sharing metadata.
